note: Strategy Earn routing v2 deployments (cre8-contracts deployments/*.json `borrowV2`). The backend reads every v2 address from here (or from STRATEGY_EARN_V2_DEPLOYMENT, which wins): executor, registry, lens, the cash swapper, the session-key scope and the paymaster allowlist all follow this file. After a redeploy, replace the entry (a new executor needs a new cash swapper); routes and vaults are discovered from the registry, they are not listed here. `cashSwapper`: AtpBorrowCashSwapper (docs/borrow-routing-v2 §17) bound to this executor — `address` is what the backend uses, `pools` are informational (`poolOf` on chain decides). `canaryOwners`: owners whose accounts use v2 while STRATEGY_EARN_V2_AUDIENCE is unset; empty = v2 is off for everyone (v1 for all). 2026-11-25: the draft6 set (executor 0xeddd…600F) replaced the draft5 one (executor 0x494C…6bB5, registry paused, no principal left on any of its 66 routes); the only canary owner is the e2e harness wallet.
